== Description ==

Group photograph of attendees in front of Zu den Vier Winden at the [[2024 World Championship]]. Faces are numbered left to right across the photograph (standing and kneeling together); kneeling players are marked. 24 people are named and 30 are unknown.

* 1. Unknown: standing far left; black Detroit Tigers "D" cap, sunglasses, beard, grey Kappa T-shirt, black shorts.
* 2. Unknown: green-and-white plaid shirt, dark trousers, short greying hair and stubble.
* 3. Unknown: back, behind #2; dark wavy hair, glasses, beard, dark shirt.
* 4. Unknown: second row, behind #5; dark hair, sunglasses.
* 5. [[Mike Kessling]]: standing front row; blue New Allies SWCCG T-shirt, black shorts.
* 6. Unknown: back, behind #4 and #7; dark hair, goatee, dark shirt.
* 7. Unknown: second row, between #5 and #8; long straight brown hair, clean-shaven.
* 8. Unknown: dark floral shirt, greying hair and beard.
* 9. [[Casper Jørgensen]]: back, behind #10; green T-shirt, sunglasses, grey-flecked dark beard.
* 10. Unknown: standing front row; white BB-8 graphic T-shirt, black trousers, sandy hair, beard.
* 11. Unknown: second row, between #10 and #12; receding hair, sunglasses, beard, black shirt.
* 12. [[Casey Anis]]: standing front row; yellow "GOTHAM CITY ROGUES" T-shirt, jeans, bald, light beard.
* 13. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]: back, behind #14; receding sandy-brown hair, glasses, tan shirt.
* 14. [[Emil Wallin]]: standing front row, right of #12; black T-shirt, dark swept-back hair, light beard.
* 15. [[AJ Hatoum]]: kneeling front row; dark teal T-shirt, grey trousers, glasses, wristwatch.
* 16. [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]]: back, behind #14 and #17; bald, clean-shaven, smiling.
* 17. [[Chris Menzel]]: standing behind #15; black "Chris Menzel / Hall of Fame" polo, sunglasses, white hair and beard.
* 18. [[Eric Hunter]]: back, tallest in window; olive-green T-shirt, backpack straps.
* 19. Unknown: standing front centre; black T-shirt with small white chest graphic, plaid shorts, sunglasses, dark curly hair and beard.
* 20. [[Joe Olson]]: second row, behind #19; glasses, reddish beard, smiling, white/grey T-shirt.
* 21. [[Brian Fred]]: back, behind #20 and #22; bald, glasses, grey-white beard, black T-shirt.
* 22. Unknown: second row, behind #24; receding dark hair, long back hair, short beard, black sleeveless metal tank top (same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship tournament room 1.jpg]] and [[:File:2024 World Championship Slack 20 September 02.jpg]]).
* 23. [[Hayes Hunter]]: back, in window beside #18; navy T-shirt, short hair, stubble.
* 24. [[Robbie Hendon]]: kneeling front row; navy cap with a red brim and a colourful logo, dark grey T-shirt, black backpack, light-wash jeans, thumbs-up.
* 25. Unknown: second row, behind #27; sandy-brown hair, clean-shaven, black T-shirt.
* 26. Unknown: back, behind #25 and #27; grey cap, sunglasses, beard.
* 27. Unknown: standing behind #24; grey T-shirt, grey cap, glasses, jeans.
* 28. [[Karl Koenig]]: back, behind #27 and #29; dark hair, smiling.
* 29. [[Dan Tartaglione]]: standing front row; cyan-and-black plaid shirt, khaki cargo shorts.
* 30. Unknown: second row, behind #29 and #32; short light-brown hair, light beard, smiling.
* 31. Unknown: back, behind #30; dark-and-white cap, white collared shirt, smiling.
* 32. [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]]: standing behind #33; black "IRON EMPIRE" graphic T-shirt, moustache, denim shorts.
* 33. [[Thomas Santosuosso]]: kneeling front row; black cap with yellow/green SWCCG patch, navy T-shirt, grey shorts, thumbs-up.
* 34. Unknown: back, in doorway behind #35; dark hair, glasses, beard, black T-shirt, thumbs-up.
* 35. [[Timo Dusel]]: standing front row; black T-shirt with small chest logo, denim shorts.
* 36. Unknown: back, in doorway; light-brown hair in a ponytail, reddish-brown beard, black T-shirt (same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship tournament room 2.jpg]]).
* 37. Unknown: kneeling front row; black cap, glasses, white long-sleeve "DAYS" T-shirt, jeans.
* 38. Unknown: back, in doorway; tall, bald, short beard, brown shirt.
* 39. Unknown: second row, behind #41; light-pink T-shirt, short brown hair, stubble (same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship SWU warm-up side event 6.jpg]]).
* 40. Unknown: back, peeking between #38 and #41; partly hidden.
* 41. [[Kevin Jaap]]: standing front row; white "1 of 1 Chase Collectibles" polo, bald, glasses, grey shorts.
* 42. Unknown: back, behind #41; bald, dark-rimmed glasses, greying beard, black T-shirt (same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship Slack 22 September 01.jpg]]).
* 43. Unknown: kneeling front row; grey-and-white striped T-shirt, glasses, short beard.
* 44. [[Erik Spijksma]]: second row, behind #41 and #46; bright blue T-shirt, glasses, short dark hair.
* 45. [[Patrik Csapi]]: back, behind #44; long dark hair, full dark beard, black T-shirt.
* 46. Unknown: standing front row; black T-shirt with small chest logo, bald, glasses, goatee.
* 47. [[Scott Lingrell]]: kneeling front row; grey "BUCKS COUNTY BASEBALL CO." T-shirt, khaki shorts, white hair, glasses.
* 48. Unknown: second row, behind #46 and #49; light-pink T-shirt, glasses, beard.
* 49. [[Tamás Papp]]: standing front row; bright blue T-shirt, black shorts, silver wristwatch.
* 50. Unknown: back, between #49 and #51; bald, glasses.
* 51. [[Brad Eier]]: standing right of #49; dark grey T-shirt, glasses, beard.
* 52. Unknown: back, in window, tall; dark hair, glasses, dark shirt.
* 53. Unknown: standing right of #51; white T-shirt with Hungarian flag ("MAGYARORSZÁG"), grey hair and beard, glasses.
* 54. Unknown: standing far right; backwards black cap, glasses, grey T-shirt, maroon shorts, grey sling bag, holding a glass mug (same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship tournament room 1.jpg]]).
